description: This file implements part of the Slap Sco Standard Object for the Service Logic Aggregation Plane. It defines functions for importing and exporting object data content, namely 'SlapScoStdImportMe' and 'SlapScoStdExportMe', which are currently stubbed to return 'unapplicable' status.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapScoStdImportMe(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,SLAP_PARAMETER_LIST * param_list)
methods.description: Imports the object data content; currently a stub returning 'unapplicable' status.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapScoStdExportMe(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,SLAP_PARAMETER_LIST ** param_list)
methods.description: Exports the object data content; currently a stub setting parameter list to NULL and returning 'unapplicable' status.
